verification_summary.balance_notes: Race beaverton-council-pos-1. Kocher has 4 bio and 6 positions (5 T1, 1 T3). Philip has 3 bio and 5 positions (4 T1, 1 T3). Coverage is balanced, and both campaign sites blocked fetches (documented). The spot-search found no further T1/T2/T3 material, only excluded aggregators. Position 1 is held by 'Ashley' (beavertonoregon.gov/832), so both incumbent=false is supported. File-level: name matches pamphlet/official listing. Incumbent false confirmed: Position 1 page names the holder as 'Ashley' (joined fall 2021). Website https://rachelforbeaverton.com confirmed as printed in the 2026 county pamphlet.
